title: Swiftthistle
wikitext:
'''Swiftthistle''' is a [[herb]] [[crafting reagent]]. Unlike most herbs, Swiftthistle is not gathered in herb nodes, but instead has a chance to be gathered when picking [[Briarthorn]] and [[Mageroyal]]. It is also rarely dropped by a number of [[mobs]].
